scope.zh: 击杀野生缇扬奇后：是否违反《缇扬奇保护法》。
scope.en: After killing wild Tiyanki: whether it breaches the Tiyanki Conservation Act.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现击杀雄性缇扬奇的数量。
note.en: In the game, the number of bulls you have killed appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现击杀缇扬奇幼崽的数量。
note.en: In the game, the number of calves you have killed appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现击杀雌性缇扬奇的数量。
note.en: In the game, the number of cows you have killed appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现击杀缇扬奇幼体的数量。
note.en: In the game, the number of hatchlings you have killed appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现击杀缇扬奇成年体的数量。
note.en: In the game, the number of oxen you have killed appears here.
